title: SUPER. VI. A giant molecular halo around a z∼2 quasar
question: Is there extended molecular (CO(3-2)) gas in the circumgalactic medium of the z~2 quasar cid_346 beyond its ISM, how far does it extend, and how much molecular gas could it hold?

data.arrays: ACA (new data, 2019.2.00118.S) and ALMA snapshot (same data as Circosta+21)
data.angular_resolution: ACA 9.3 arcsec (~80 kpc); ALMA 1.0 arcsec; ALMA-t (4 arcsec taper) 3.4 arcsec
data.sensitivity: 1 sigma per channel: ACA 4.0 mJy/beam (6 km/s); ALMA 0.7 mJy/beam (22 km/s); ALMA-t 1.4 mJy/beam (22 km/s); PWV 5.2 mm (ACA), 1.8 mm (ALMA)

what.value: ISM CO(3-2) flux of cid_346 (r<~8 kpc), 0.63+-0.09 Jy km/s, adopted as the fiducial ISM value

evidence.quote: fiducial ISM (cite: Circosta+21)
our fiducial ISM value is the one measured by (cite: Circosta+21) at $r\lesssim8$ kpc
The 3mm continuum flux density measured in cid_346 by (cite: Circosta+21) using ALMA is $0.15\pm0.04$ mJy.

what.value: Target properties: stellar mass and SFR from Circosta+18; bolometric luminosity, black hole mass, Eddington ratio from Vietri+20

evidence.quote: $^{\dag}$ (cite: Circosta+18); $^{\ddag}$ (cite: Vietri+20).

external_data.citation: Circosta et al. 2018 (cite: Circosta+18); Vietri et al. 2020 (cite: Vietri+20)

what.value: Average [CI](2-1)/[CI](1-0) luminosity ratio 0.47 (Tex = 26 K) and X_CI = 1.6e-5 for main-sequence galaxies at z>1

evidence.quote: provide average values of $L^{\prime}_{\rm [CI](2-1)}/L^{\prime}_{\rm [CI](1-0)}= 0.47$ (corresponding to $T_{ex}=26$ K) and $X_{\rm CI}= 1.6\times 10^{-5}$ for the ISM of main sequence galaxies at $z>1$.

external_data.citation: Valentino et al. 2018 (cite: Valentino+18); Valentino et al. 2020 (cite: Valentino+20)

evidence.quote: (including the Helium correction) for the molecular ISM of $z\sim2$ galaxies (see references in (cite: Circosta+21))

external_data.citation: references in Circosta et al. 2021 (cite: Circosta+21)

what.value: Optical/IR imaging of the field (Subaru/HSC from Laigle+16; Spitzer from Mehta+18)

evidence.quote: $^{\dag}$ (cite: Laigle+16); $^{\ddag}$ (cite: Mehta+18).

external_data.citation: Laigle et al. 2016 (cite: Laigle+16); Mehta et al. 2018 (cite: Mehta+18)

recipe.goal: Reduce and image the ACA CO(3-2) data
recipe.method: Calibrated MS from the standard pipeline scriptForPI; cubes cleaned with tclean using interactive masks, no continuum subtraction; spectra from primary-beam corrected cubes

recipe.goal: Reduce the archival ALMA CO(3-2) data and make a tapered cube
recipe.method: CASA pipeline, uv-plane continuum subtraction with a linear polynomial, Briggs imaging, plus a 4 arcsec tapered cube (ALMA-t)
key_parameters: robust = 0.5; uv taper 4 arcsec; maximum spectral resolution 22 km/s

recipe.method: Collapsed line-free spw17 map to place an upper limit on the continuum

recipe.goal: Extract spectra in apertures, fit Gaussians, build the curve of growth
recipe.method: CO(3-2) spectra extracted from several apertures of ALMA (r = 0.6-10 arcsec) and ACA (r > 10 arcsec) cubes, fitted with Gaussians; fluxes plotted against aperture radius
key_parameters: ACA spectra rebinned to 160 km/s; single broad Gaussian per aperture; ALMA-t fluxes from elliptical apertures (a=15, b=10 arcsec and a=20, b=15 arcsec)
assumptions: The additional component at v~1500 km/s is too faint to fit and is excluded from the single-Gaussian fits

recipe.method: uv visibilities modelled as a circular Gaussian plus a point source
assumptions: Unresolved ISM represented by a point source

recipe.goal: Bound the molecular gas mass of the CGM (CO)
recipe.method: Lower limits from the J=3 column density and from LTE; upper limit assuming optically thick CO, alpha_CO(1-0) = 3.6 and r31 = 0.5, using L'CO(3-2) = (24+-7)e10 K km/s pc^2
assumptions: All CO(3-2) emission treated equally (ISM and CGM share the same conditions)
Upper limit assumes optically thick CO throughout the CGM

recipe.goal: Convert the APEX [CI](2-1) non-detection into limits
recipe.method: 3 sigma flux upper limit from the rms, assuming the same line profile as CO(3-2) (FWHM ~ 1000 km/s); mass limit from Tex and X_CI
key_parameters: flux density conversion 40+-7 Jy/K; rms 7.0+-1.2 mJy per 50 km/s
assumptions: [CI](2-1)/[CI](1-0) = 0.47 (Tex = 26 K) and X_CI = 1.6e-5 from literature averages

recipe.goal: Make moment maps of the ACA cube
recipe.method: CASA immoments with a velocity window and flux threshold
key_parameters: v in [-300, 300] km/s; threshold 0.04 Jy/beam km/s
